welcome.heroSubtitle: Flask REST API, Alpine.js SPA, cookie auth + OAuth, billing, i18n, SEO modes, and Docker — a production-ready starter so you focus on your idea, not boilerplate.
welcome.carouselSubtitle: Everything below ships in the box — no add-ons required.
welcome.slide1Desc: Vite proxies /api to Flask — zero CORS pain.
welcome.slide2Desc: HttpOnly session cookie and CSRF on mutating requests — Google and Facebook OAuth included.
welcome.slide3Desc: Lemon Squeezy adapter with checkout, webhooks, and entitlements — swap providers via BILLING_PROVIDER.
welcome.slide4Desc: Add a locale JSON file, wire t() in templates and controllers — EN | PT switcher on day one.
welcome.slide5Desc: Interactive Swagger UI — every route documented.
welcome.slide6Desc: Vite build lands in backend/static/ — Flask serves /api and the SPA from one Docker image.
welcome.featureBackendDesc: Models, blueprints, pytest coverage, and Alembic before you touch UI.
welcome.featureFrontendDesc: Alpine.js controllers + Handlebars templates — no framework lock-in.
welcome.featureSeoDesc: auth-first or public-first modes with /robots.txt and page metadata.
welcome.featureBillingDesc: Lemon Squeezy adapter, checkout, webhooks, and entitlements — swap providers via BILLING_PROVIDER.
welcome.featureI18nDesc: Locale JSON files, t() in templates and controllers, EN | PT switcher included.
welcome.footerTagline: Fork it, set your .env, and ship.
welcome.footerCopyright: © 2026 Vanilla WebApp Framework · Built with Flask, Alpine.js & Tailwind
